name: Sidekick
description: Editorial assistant that fetches ChatGPT-generated content suggestions from a Sidekick API and surfaces them while creating Drupal content.
project_description:
AI Sidekick is your personal writing assistant powered by ChatGPT, that helps you create better texts faster and find brilliant content ideas. Create content 10x faster, brainstorm new ideas, and turn thoughts into brilliant text. Based on the latest findings in the field of artificial intelligence.

 Features 
 ✅ Based on the world's best AIs

AI Sidekick uses the OpenAI GPT-4 language model for text generation, which is only available to select companies. The quality massively exceeds that of the free ChatGPT version, based on GPT-3. Likewise, we incorporate other high-end AIs such as DeepL and Azure Computer Vision. Our team reads several AI research papers every week, and we continuously implement the most exciting approaches to keep you at the forefront.

 ✅ A clear focus - creating brilliant texts quickly

Our models are trained to generate and optimize texts. This allows us to achieve exceptional results.

 ✅ Developed as an assistant

Creating completely automated texts doesn't work.

Our innovative tools guide you in ideation, structuring, and crafting impeccable text to exponentially boost your productivity. We always want to assist, so you can always have texts refined by your instructions in the chat.

 Additional Requirements 
 There is a free account, but you will need an API Key if you use AI Sidekick on a daily basis.

 Post-Installation 
 Begin your journey with a free account or explore the full potential of AI Sidekick with a premium subscription at https://ai-sidekick.app/en/pricing 

You can add your API Key and configure the module over at /admin/config/services/sidekick 

 Back to top
